fix validates candidate roots with _is_repo_checkout() checking for .git and src/rebar before using them, falling back to git rev-parse --show-toplevel with bounded timeout, else raising a clear error naming REBAR_ROOT and --repo-root
new RED test proves the raise-on-non-checkout case and CWD fallback behavior; existing REBAR_ROOT-set and editable-install behavior must remain unchanged

sibling guard scripts/check_repo_root_from_package.py enforces the invariant that reconciler repo-root is never derived raw from Path(__file__).parents[N] package location, gating any future reintroductions in CI
